derivation_notes.artifacts_importance: Manifests are pheromone markers (stigmergy). High count = dense signaling = emergence opportunity.
derivation_notes.quality_importance: High-quality manifests contain accurate routing. Quality × Emergence = signal amplification (good) vs noise (bad).
derivation_notes.emergence_importance: Monkeybranching depth proxies for multi-agent knowledge transfer. Depth N compounds discovery exponentially.
derivation_notes.tokens_importance: Efficiency normalization. FFMx/T penalizes high-burn, low-output work. Core advantage of faerie2 = same work, fewer tokens.
derivation_notes.exponent_rationale: k=1.5 empirically fits (2^1.5≈2.8, 3^1.5≈5.2). Conservative; may tune to 1.3–1.7 post-W2 measurement.
